item: A busy store reads busy, the retry says why, and the expedition tests pin the machine (rows 153, 152)
key_paths: src/database/at_rest_state.py; src/api/unlock.py; src/custody/log.py; src/static/app-backup.js; tests/test_store_swap_identity_r148.py; tests/test_expedition_log.py
summary: A store in use (SQLite 5/6, Windows 32/33) reads busy: never a read error or pending, never cached, blocks complete. The retry's 409 with nothing pending names a busy or not-this-passphrase store. Settings names unchecked and not-this-passphrase stores. status() always tries the held key and reports key_held. Custody reads racing a swap answer replaced (checked before and after). test_expedition_log read the live machine's memory floor and failed under load; the reading is pinned, the floor side has its own test. x12.
